items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I made an album with him and Buck Clayton

ctx.x: -- I know, but the second time, you know, he -- he played so many beautiful ballads, you know. He -- I made an album with him and Buck Clayton, and, you know, so he said, well, what do you want me to play? I said, you play what you want. Now,
"You've" he came and he played whole Changed.

items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: we met him at the boat and we played a lot of things for him and Mezzrow was here then, Sidney Bechet Happy Caldwell, Jack Butler, a lot of them.

ctx.x: having trouble with his wife. She was putting him down. So we all saved up enough money and caught the Isle de France and went over there. But before we went Paradisio has been to New York, he came to New York somewhere down in that time.

And he told us he said if you ever get to France just let me know and I'll arrange something for you. And we always kept that in our minds you know, because we met him at the boat and we played a lot of things for him and Mezzrow was here then, Sidney Bechet Happy Caldwell, Jack Butler, a lot of them.
We all met him at the boat and we made him kind of happy to be in the States, it was his first trip. So he said, if you ever get to Europe and I was learning to speak French at that time,
